downloadSentinel:
Testicular Torsion — Final Export

Core validation passed using Core Radiology, Second Edition, with relevant coverage on GU pages 285–288 and Nuclear Medicine page 485. Core-supported material included the time-dependent ultrasound pattern, bell-clapper mechanism, segmental-infarction and epididymitis discriminators, salvage timing, and radionuclide appearance.

The final deck contains 59 cards and exactly 59 TSV lines, each with 22 columns, no header row, no embedded line breaks, and a blank Tags column:

- 25 Primary UNKNOWN cards covering all 25 atomic cases and all 31 selected images
- 6 pattern-distinct Differential Drills
- 1 Definition card
- 6 Mechanism cards
- 5 Boards Trap cards
- 2 Epidemiology cards
- 14 additional High-Yield cards

Caption-integrity, source-provenance, trigger-isolation, image-cluster, ultrasound, MRI, nuclear-medicine, diagnostic-performance, structural-framework, and salvage-outcome gates passed. No external literature was used.

The ZIP contains the TSV, source-qualified case metadata, validation reports, image URL manifest, IMaios gap audit, and a Windows PowerShell image downloader. The actual image binaries are not embedded in the ZIP; running download_images.ps1 retrieves the 31 plain and 31 annotated files using the prescribed RP-/SDX-qualified filenames.
